My run of reference/tests/test_concurrency.py::test_call_from_thread with PYTHONPATH=generated/src (textual confirmed imported from generated/src) timed out after 60s (exit 124). test_call_from_thread_app_not_running passed in the same environment.
Inline reproduction of the reference test's worker flow on the generated tree printed 'worker: write raised NoActiveAppError'; on the reference tree it printed 'worker: write ok' and returned 123.
Cause: generated/src/textual/app.py:1761-1768 never calls _set_active(); reference/src/textual/app.py:647-650 does. Callback reaches generated/src/textual/widgets/_text_log.py:94 (self.app.console).
criteria.deficiency: A FAIL_TO_PASS test (reference test_call_from_thread) hangs against the generated implementation because the callback cannot resolve the active app. The recorded reference_tests pass cannot be reconciled with my direct run without knowing which tree the evaluation phase used. The candidate's own async tests fail only because the venv lacks pytest-asyncio; they do not test widget access from a callback.

reference/tests/test_concurrency.py:16-33 requires a worker thread to call call_from_thread(write_stuff) where write_stuff writes to a TextLog via self.app.query_one(TextLog).write(text), then exit with code 123.
On the generated tree this raises NoActiveAppError inside the callback (inline reproduction above), the worker thread dies before calling exit, and the run hangs (my 60s timeout run, exit 124).
generated/src/textual/app.py:1761-1768 lacks the _set_active() step that the reference uses to make callbacks behave like app code (reference/src/textual/app.py:647-650).
criteria.deficiency: The feature's central use case (calling widget-touching code from a worker thread and getting the result back) does not work. Only the error paths and trivial callbacks that never touch self.app behave correctly.
